proof_body:
by
  intro n i j hn
  haveI : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
  refine ⟨?_, DihedralGroup.orderOf_r_one, DihedralGroup.orderOf_sr i, DihedralGroup.nat_card⟩
  simp
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (i j : ZMod n), 0 < n → (DihedralGroup.sr i * DihedralGroup.r j * DihedralGroup.sr i = (DihedralGroup.r (-j) : DihedralGroup n)) ∧ orderOf (DihedralGroup.r 1 : DihedralGroup n) = n ∧ orderOf (DihedralGroup.sr i : DihedralGroup n) = 2 ∧ (Nat.card (DihedralGroup n) = 2 * n)
